origin.valkery.valkyrie.description: A winged champion chosen by the All-Father. Your divine vitality grants four extra hearts. Your Icarus wings are bound to you; movement trains your flight mastery. Flight consumes a little hunger, and tired wings or a heavy blow begin a safe, slow descent. Any bow deals 25% more damage, while melee attacks deal 25% less.
power.valkery.valkyrie_wings.name: Wings of the Valkyrie
power.valkery.valkyrie_wings.description: Receive Icarus wings and have them equipped automatically in the back slot. Choose their type and color with /valkery wings. The wings are bound to you; double-tap jump to fly.
power.valkery.valkyrie_vitality.name: Valkyrie Vitality
power.valkery.valkyrie_vitality.descript: Your divine resilience grants you four additional hearts.
message.valkery.wings_tired: Your wings are tired. Land and let them recover.
message.valkery.wings_disrupted: A heavy blow disrupts your wings. Land safely before flying again.
message.valkery.wings_hungry: You need at least three hunger icons to fly. Your wings carry you down safely.
message.valkery.mastery.progress: Flight mastery: %1$s — %2$d/%3$d XP (%4$d to next rank).
message.valkery.bow_mastery.progress: Divine Smite skill: %1$d/5 — %2$d/%3$d bow XP (%4$d until next upgrade). Use /valkery bow upgrade to spend XP.
message.valkery.bow_mastery.max: Divine Smite skill: max level %1$d (%2$d bow XP).
message.valkery.bow_mastery.need_experie: You need %1$d bow XP to upgrade Divine Smite.
message.valkery.bow_mastery.max_level: Divine Smite is already at max level.
message.valkery.wings.usage: Choose with /valkery wings set <type> <color> or /valkery wings unique <flandres|discords|zanzas>.
message.valkery.wings.invalid_style: That wing style or color is not available.
message.valkery.wings.unavailable: Icarus wing item %1$s is not installed or available.
message.valkery.wings.origin_required: Choose the Valkyrie Origin to bind and customize wings.
